findings: No actual artifacts were supplied to this lane — no data files, code, hash manifests, or deterministic-replay logs — only a textual plan description. A genuine 'data integrity' audit cannot be performed on prose alone; this response evaluates the plan's methodology on paper only.

Per-symbol H1 family/hour/entry-geometry coordinate search across 94 symbols is a large per-symbol search space. 'Independent, no pooling' avoids cross-symbol leakage but does not remove within-symbol multiplicity risk — each symbol still runs many candidate configurations, so a corrected significance threshold (e.g., per-symbol deflated Sharpe / FDR across the geometry grid) is needed or the 80% win-rate / positive-expectancy results can be overfit noise even without touching FINAL.

80% minimum win rate at RR 1:2 with only 1-3 eligible executions/day is a tight statistical bar; the plan doesn't state a minimum eligible-day/trade-count floor per symbol. Small-sample symbols could clear the 80% threshold by chance. Need an explicit minimum-N gate before a symbol's result is trusted.

Crypto H1 OKX-first with 'continuity-checked fallbacks' and Forex Twelve Data M5 are two different provider/timeframe pipelines feeding the same research process. Provider fallback and any M5→H1 handling are common sources of look-ahead/leakage (differing bar-close conventions, gap-fill using future data). No description of how continuity checks are validated as strictly causal (only past bars used).

'Same-bar SL' is stated as conservative, but conservatism should be verified against worst-case intrabar path (e.g., using available lower-timeframe data to confirm SL-before-TP ordering within the bar), not just asserted.
